theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_ss_boundary_eq_of_tsupport_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary θ = ∫ x, ξ' x ((θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), A ω = ∫ x in S, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, B θ = ∫ x in S, ξ' x ((θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → ∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ⊆ S → A.boundary θ = B θ
